title: Bing Paid Advertising | PPC Advertising in Washington DC

facts.fact: Microsoft Advertising, formerly Bing Ads, is described by the page as a paid advertising channel for organizations that serve B2B and B2G professionals.
facts.quote: Microsoft Advertising, formerly Bing Ads, has also become a strategic channel for organizations that cater to B2B and B2G professionals.

facts.fact: The page states that Microsoft Advertising places ads across the Microsoft Search Network, including Bing, Yahoo, AOL, and other partner websites.
facts.quote: places ads across the Microsoft Search Network, including Bing, Yahoo, AOL, and other partner websites

facts.fact: The page says Microsoft Advertising ads can reach users of Windows PC, Microsoft Edge, Outlook, Office, Xbox, and LinkedIn.
facts.quote: Your ads can reach Windows PC, Microsoft Edge, Outlook, Office, Xbox, and LinkedIn users

facts.fact: The page states that Microsoft Advertising and Google Ads both offer demographic segmentation by age, gender, income level, and geographic location.
facts.quote: allowing advertisers to target audiences based on age, gender, income level, geographic location, and other factors

facts.fact: The page cites a WordStream blog figure, which it attributes to a third party rather than to the vendor's own data, stating that Microsoft Advertising's cost-per-click hovers around $1.54.
